description: This file defines an Android activity 'PathEffects' demonstrating different PathEffect styles applied to a Path in a custom View. It includes method implementations for creating specific path effects, rendering the path with various effects, and handling key events for interaction.

classes.name: PathEffects
classes.description: Android activity class that hosts the custom drawing for path effects demonstration.

classes.name: PathEffects.SampleView
classes.description: Inner custom View class that manages drawing the path with various path effects and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to the custom SampleView.

methods.name: makeDash
methods.description: Creates a DashPathEffect with a specific pattern and phase.

methods.name: makeEffects
methods.description: Populates an array of PathEffect objects with different effects.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor setting up paint, path, effects, color array, and focus properties.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the background, applies effects to the path, and renders each with different path effects.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events to regenerate the path when the center D-Pad button is pressed.

methods.name: makeFollowPath
methods.description: Creates a Path that meanders randomly, simulating a 'follow' shape.

methods.name: makePathDash
methods.description: Creates a Path used as a shape for PathDashPathEffect.
